data.name: Leonid
data.gender_notes: Leonid is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word leon, meaning lion. Leonid is a name of ancient Greek origin that signifies strength and courage. It was borne by several early Christian saints and martyrs, as well as by a meteor shower named the Leonids. The name Leonid carries the meaning “Lion, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leonid usually hope their child will grow to embody lion, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage and inner strength
data.etymology: Leonid belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion, warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leonid total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: ליאוניד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ליאוניד הוא שילוב של המילים היווניות 'ליאון' שפירושה אריה ו'ידוס' שפירושה דומה או בן, ולכן ניתן לפרש אותו כדומה לאריה או בן האריה. השם נגזר מהשורש היווני 'ליאון' שפירושו אריה, ומשמש לתיאור אדם חזק ואמיץ. השימוש בשם זה בקרב הנוצרים הוא ככל הנראה בהשראת המסורת היוונית והרומית, אך הוא אינו מופיע ישירות בכתבי הקודש העבריים או הנוצריים.

in_greek.name: Λεωνίδ
in_greek.meaning: παρόμοιος με λέων, ισχυρός και γενναίος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λεωνίδ προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'λέων' που σημαίνει λιοντάρι και 'ίδ' που σημαίνει παρόμοιος ή γιος, και επομένως μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως παρόμοιος με λιοντάρι ή γιος του λιονταρίου. Η χρήση αυτού του ονόματος στην αρχαία Ελλάδα ήταν σύνηθες για να περιγράψει κάποιον που έχει τις ιδιότητες του λιονταριού, δηλαδή τη δύναμη και το θάρρος. Στην παράδοση των πρώτων Χριστιανών, το όνομα αυτό μπορεί να χρησιμοποιήθηκε για να συμβολίσει την πνευματική δύναμη και την ανδρεία στην πίστη.

in_latin.name: Leonid
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Leonid derivatur ex vocabulis Graecis 'leon' quod significat leonem et 'id' quod significat similem vel filium, itaque interpretari potest tamquam leoni similem vel leonis filium. Usus huius nominis in traditione Christiana primitiva probabiliter fuit inspiratus traditione Graeca et Romana, sed non invenitur directe in Scripturis Sacris. Nomen hoc saepe dabatur hominibus qui virtutem et fortitudinem in fide demonstraverunt.

in_english.name: Leonid
in_english.meaning: Similar to a lion, strong and courageous
in_english.long_meaning: The name Leonid originates from the Greek words 'leon' meaning lion and 'id' meaning similar or son, thus it can be interpreted as similar to a lion or son of a lion. This name was commonly used in ancient Greece to describe someone with the qualities of a lion, namely strength and bravery. In Christian tradition, the name Leonid may have been used to symbolize spiritual strength and courage in faith. The name Leonid is associated with Saint Leonid of Alexandria, a 4th-century bishop and martyr. The name has been adopted in various cultures and remains popular among Christian families due to its strong, spiritual connotations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Leonid carries a rich history and cultural significance, particularly rooted in ancient Greece and the Christian tradition. It is a powerful name that reflects the strength, valor, and determination associated with the symbol of a lion. This name has been borne by many early Christian saints and martyrs, reflecting their bravery and commitment to their faith. Additionally, the name Leonid is connected to the Leonid meteor shower, further emphasizing theconnection between the name and the might and endurance of nature. In many cultures, the lion is also seen as a symbol of royalty and power, reflecting the name's regal connotations.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Leonid holds significant spiritual meaning for Christians, who view the name as a reminder of God's overwhelming power and protection. The lion, as mentioned earlier, is a symbol often used in the Bible to represent Christ, as described in various passages such as Isaiah 31:4, Psalm 44:11, and Revelation 5:5. Thus, the name Leonid can be interpreted as a divine name, bestowed upon those who possess a strong and unwavering faith in God. It serves as a source of inspiration and an encouragement to be courageous and steadfast in the face of adversity, just as the early Christian saints and martyrs did. Additionally, the Leonid meteor shower serves as a reminder of the wonders and mysteries of the natural world, reminding us of God's infinite power and majesty.
